data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves moved favourably in 2018 with an aggregate gross release of approximately GBP 22.7m (4.6% of opening gross claims outstanding). The syndicate reports a net favourable development (after reinsurance) of GBP 3.5m driven by releases in Third Party Liability and reinsurance acceptances and assisted by the return of certain claims following resolution of a dispute over historic binding authority agreements (legal resolution returning ~GBP 11.75m). The gross release was measured using the syndicate's gross claims development table; the movement note quoted net (after reinsurance) figures only.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.5m (2017: favourable development of GBP 14.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 1.9m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.5m in respect of total Reinsurance business.

In addition to the favourable development reported above, the Syndicate result has also benefited from the resolution of a dispute between Newline Corporate Name Limited and a third party administrator, in respect of a number of historic binding authority agreements with the Syndicate. This has resulted in the return of certain claims paid under these binding authority agreements and legal costs totalling GBP 11.75m.

carrying value of net claims IBNR is GBP 249.9m (2017: GBP 228.9m), and the Management Adjustment in excess of the best estimate of net reserves was GBP 28.9m (2017: GBP 24.1m).
data.data_quality_notes: The formal 'Movement in prior year's provision' note reports only net (after reinsurance) movement. A gross prior year movement was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) as the gross movement is required by the specification. All primary monetary values in main fields are converted to millions. The P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines were ignored per instructions (they are claims incurred, not reserve movements). Triangle values were converted from GBP '000 to millions for consistency. No RITC disclosure was found to indicate distortion of the triangle.
